comment: The expectations when you start this clear are very high, but Tenace makes them extremely clear. I can't say I didn't learn a lot, because truly, I really enjoyed the content and Tenace does a great job of teaching the content, sometimes it just gets a bit harder than it has to be because of some policies Tenace has.
Always takes questions, is an amazing proffessor

As an international student, I love the perspective Tenace brings to class. He ties real-world problems into everything and you can tell he cares about us learnin not just for the grade but for life after college. His teaching is hads on and he is funny. If you want to actually learn something useful I will recommend his class.
The classes are hard. But he gives you everything you need to succeed. He gives you the exam questions weeks before the exam. Do the homework, go to the office hours and pay attention in class.

Tenace is not a great professor. He talks to students and moves too quickly through the material. He asks if everyone understands but then does not wait for everyone to complete each step. He is not very approachable, so if you are struggling, it may be hard to get help. I would not recommend him.
Pros: Good professor. classes are very hands on and engaging. knowledgeable. Cons: very intimidating. tough grader.
Not good in terms of explaining things. Not helpful outside class.

He's super chill and lets us call him by his first name. The material actually sticks because he makes everything interesting with his random funny stories. don't think it's an easy A just cause he's laid back. You gotta do the hw and practice constantly. But fr if you put in decent effort you will be okay.

I was honestly surprised to see a few negative reviews about Professor Tenace so I just had to chime in. I absolutely love, love, love him! He explains everything so clearly and really makes sure you understand the material. Yes, his expectations are high, but that just pushes you to be your best.

Tenace is charismatic. He is encouraging in office hours. You need to be on your toes as he moves pretty quickly through material. However, he pushes his students towards excellence with challenging exams and a real-world group project in connection with a real business. You will be rewarded by learning a lot and gaining great skills for a résumé.

He gives you the exam questions a few weeks before the exam. Go to class, office hours and do hte homework. He is hilarious and makes the classes fun. People are just dramatic with the negative reviews because they want an easy A. LOL

You have to work a bit harder in his class but his classes are fun. You have to prepare before class and do the homework after class. Do not wait till the week of the exam. Practice Practice Practice. He makes his classes fun and i did not want to miss class. Demands a lot from you but in a good way.

I have a lot of respect for Tenace but he was not my favorite as a professor. His class moves very quickly which can be stressful and his tests can be challenging even with a lot of preparation. It is possible to do well in his class- and he will appreciate you for it- but it will take many hours of hard work.

Actually looked forward to his classes because they are fun and engaging. If you stay on top of the homework and review the material regularly you will be well-prepared for his exams. He is very good at making complex things like regression and stats very enjoyable. I am very interested in analytics now even though that is not myconcentration.

Fun and interesting! Hands on class and the group project is intense but you'll work with a real business to gain real experience. Everything we worked on was very intentional and there's no busy work. I would recommend but the tests are extremely hard and the exam banks were so time consuming. Very helpful class for our future business careers!

Best prof I've had in the B school so far! Definitely do the homework and go to his office hours - he's super chill and actually wants to help you succeed. He gives you an exam question bank too, which is a total lifesaver. I was kinda nervous about taking his class, but I ended up learning a ton and really enjoyed it. His classes are fun too lol
He literally gives you the exam questions before the test date by a couple of weeks. just know how to do the questions and you should get a comfortable A.

Beware, do not take this class. There is a reason this is the last IT Data course to fill up during registration. His exams are brutal and reviewing for them can take over 10 hours and you have no idea if you're doing the problems right. Avoid this class if you can

Professor Tenace wants you to succeed. Go to the office hours, do the homework and practice exam questions. There is no other way around it. He has very high expectations of students and is very plain-spoken which sometimes comes across as harsh.

Tenace is a professor that is willing to help you beyond the scope of the class. He also cares less about the hard material learned in class and more about the applications of the knowledge outside of class. It is a tough course but he is always willing to help you when help is needed.

Classes are fun and he is hilarious. If you do the homework, go to the office hours and practice the exam bank questions, you will be fine. If you wait till the exam and cram everything you will not do well. If you are lazy and expect an easy A avoid him.

I fooled by the high rate my professor score but he was so mean and awful. His tests are the hardest thing and he doesn't give answers on thetest bank so you have no idea if you're doing it right or wrong. However, he did give peer reviews because some members didn't try on the final group project. You may be fine but I would avoid him

Possibly one of the best experiences I have had in RBS. Working on a real-life consulting project and presenting to the client in class was very different from anything I have experienced in the business school. Sure, his classes can be challenging, and he is friendly but also can give off a no-nonsense vibe. But I learned so much from this class!
I love love love Tenace! 10/10 recommend.

Class was enjoyable. Exams can be hard but if you do the homework questions and exam bank you will be ok. He is friendly and very accessible but he brings his whole personality to class so beware because he will call you out if you are not paying attention or doing the homework.

He speaks really fast but he teaches very well. Classes are hands on. There are 3 exams and finals project. If you pay attention in class and do the homework, you should be okay. He shows you how the class connects with jobs and internship skills and that was very helpful for me. True G!
He talks extremely fast, but he wants you to succeed. The tests can be very difficult but he is an extremely generous grader and does not want you to fail. He is very kind and funny.

Great guy with a sense of humor. Explains everything clearly although sometimes speaks quickly. But if you go to office hours you can catch up.  Grade is mostly made up of 3 tests and a final which is a group project. The tests are challenging but if you study for them, you will be fine. Final project is challenging but was really cool to work on.

He can be super critical, and his classes are no walk in the park, but the guy genuinely cares. Forget about chasing grades. He pushes you to understand the material and develop real-world skills. It's challenging and you might question your life choices during the semester but you'll come out the other end with a solid grasp of IT Data concepts.

I found Tenace to be approachable and funny. He is a very smart guy and passionate about the course. I learned a lot from this class and the final project was very cool. This course helped me get an internship because my interview was all about the final project. Great guy. Take him but ready to work hard.

Tenace is dedicated to ensuring that you not only understand the theoretical concepts but also gain practical experience. The class does come with its challenges. The exams are undoubtedly challenging requiring a solid grasp of the material. If you're looking for a class where you can coast through exams, this might not be the one for you.

Very charismatic professor. Even though I did not get an A in this class, I thought his grading and assessment were fair. I learned a lot in this class and my summer internship was largely successful because of this class. He has very high expectations, which is not a bad thing.

Tenace is a knowledgeable and friendly IT and Data Analytics professor with a great sense of humor. His exams are tough but attending his office hours and completing homework exercises will prepare you well. A lot of people like him for different reasons but I highly recommend him if you are more interested in learning and less in grades.

Tenace is a nice guy and very friendly but don't expect an easy A. There are no textbooks but you don't need one because he actually teaches and gives out his materials. Grading criteria are clear as he provides you with a rubric during the exam. Overall 10/10 recommend if you want to learn some practical IT and data skills.

Professor Tenace is a great guy! He tells you how it is, there's no beating around the bush. He's very good at answering questions and helping you understand the material.  If you want to be lazy and not apply yourself by not doing the homework then you will find the class to be difficult. Take his classes!

Tenace is very smart and knows a lot about IT and Data. Most of the things I learned in this class came in handy during my summer internship. Take him but be prepared to work a lot. Nice and friendly guy too.

Tenace is a very smart man. He knows a lot about the subject, and he's a very friendly and nice guy. a lot of people like him a lot. Personally, I found his teaching style to be bad. He wouldn't explain a subject, instead just say "it's logic" and expect you to figure out software you've never seen before. don't love his teaching style but nice guy

Professor T succeeds in making IT Data interesting. Impressive, accessible, knowledgeable with an edgy sense of humor. Take his advice from day one of class about how to succeed in this class. You are going to have to work a lot for the A-; homework, office hours, challenging exams, and a real-life end-of-semester project. DO NOT MISS CLASS!

If there is truly a professor at the B school who has challenged me to think critically and deeply about solving business problems it has to be Professor Tenace. Enjoyed the way he makes real-world connections with things we learn in class. Not an easy A but if you want to learn and pick up some data management and IT skills take him.

Class was enjoyable. No textbook because he actually teaches, but if you don't pay attention or miss a class it will hurt you. Homework is not mandatory and tests were fair assessments. The class is difficult if you do not take the time to understand the concepts.

Professor Tenace is a friendly face in a place where I do not see many people who look like him. It is refreshing. As many have said, Tenace listens to student feedback and breaks down concepts in a way that is easy to understand. His tests can be challenging but if you do the homework and prep well you will pass. Ask lotta questions he is kind

Professor Tenace is very smart and knowledgeable. His classes are fun and engaging and you will leave every class learning something new. I liked his real-world applications of data analytics. I will likely minor in the analytics concentration.

Professor Tenace is really funny and cares about the growth of his students. He encourages you to think outside the box and provides real world experience. He incorporated student feedback well and pushed us all to grow. Take his class!

Tenace is my favorite professor in the business school so far. His tests and exams are incredibly challenging in a good way because he seems to have high expectations of students. He showed a lot of respect for us and incorporated our feedback right away. Take him if you want to build your analytics skills. He is funny AF too! I will take him again

Super knowledgeable and fun professor. Tests can be a bit heavy but as long as you prep extensively for them you'll be fine. He does have a high expectations, though. Yet he tries his best to accommodate his students and listens to feedback.

This semester seems to have been a test run, so I will try to give my evaluation with this in mind. Tenace listens to feedback about assignments and teaches info in a way very easy to understand. While there are pop quizzes, they are for extra credit. Tests are tricky, but he verbally guarantees everyone at least a B as long as minimum is done.
